summary: Bankhead National Forest fire tower site on Kinlock Knob, built between 1924 and 1930; the register shows foundations and does not say when the tower was removed.

facts.status_note: Register photo shows tower foundations; the removal date is unknown

events.note: Built between 1924 and 1930 per the register; 1924 is only the start of that range
Tower first appears on a 1930 Forest Service map
Registered December 25, 2022; nominated by Billy Wayne White

evidence.supports: site named Kinlock Knob Fire Tower Site
forest in northwest Alabama across Lawrence, Winston and Franklin Counties
evidence.quote: The Bankhead National Forest is located in the northwestern part of the state in Lawrence, Winston and Franklin Counties.

evidence.supports: first appeared on a 1930 Forest Service map
evidence.quote: This fire tower first appeared on a 1930 Forest Service map.
It is unknown when it was removed.

evidence.supports: administered by the U.S. Forest Service
register places tower in Winston County
TopoQuest places tower in Lawrence County under the name Kinlock Lookout Tower
evidence.quote: Kinlock Lookout Tower is a tower located in Lawrence County, AL

corrections.why: The register gives a range, 'between 1924 and 1930'. The record's single year reads as an exact build date.

notes_for_editor: County disagrees: register says Winston, TopoQuest says Lawrence, and the coordinates are nearly identical. The forest covers Lawrence, Winston and Franklin counties, so its extent does not settle it. Elevation: register 1,051 ft (320 m), TopoQuest 1046 ft MSL; the record uses the register. Access is not established: the Forest Service page lists recreation activities but says nothing about this knob, so no access field is set. The foundations photo is the only evidence of remains. No staffing or fire history found.
